title: Plant Care Captain
shareTitle: Plant Care Captain — Grow a Happy Plant Friend
description: Choose a tiny clay plant, then water, mist, and gently prune it until a joyful new bloom appears.
learningGoals: Practice a simple real-world plant-care sequence: water, mist, then prune
Build gentle hand control through forgiving taps and broad drag targets
Notice how consistent care changes a living thing over time
interactionModel: Choose Sunny, Pip, or Basil, then tap each chunky care tool or drag it onto the broad matching plant target three times. During pruning, tap the brown leaves directly or bring the shears to them.
feedbackModel: Every action has an immediate clay-art reaction, recorded spoken encouragement, and visible three-step progress; no action loses progress and every plant ends in a warm thriving celebration.

modes.title: Sunny
modes.skill: Care for a tall sunflower through three visible growth stages.

modes.title: Pip
modes.skill: Care for a curling pea plant and reveal its blossoms and pods.

modes.title: Basil
modes.skill: Care for a leafy herb and reveal a fresh flowering crown.
